# Regional Totals Summary Report

## Overview
This report summarizes regional transaction data from 18 records in the input dataset.

## Regional Breakdown

| Region | Total Amount (cents) | Percentage |
|--------|---------------------|-----------|
| South  | 270,675             | 36.7%     |
| North  | 254,156             | 34.4%     |
| West   | 213,798             | 29.0%     |
| **TOTAL** | **738,629**       | **100%**  |

## Key Findings
- The South region has the highest total at 270,675 cents
- The North region is close behind at 254,156 cents
- The West region accounts for 213,798 cents
- Total value across all regions: 738,629 cents (approximately $7,386.29)

## Data Notes
- Analysis based on 18 transaction records
- Records are well-distributed across the three regions
- All amounts are in cents for precise financial tracking
